王野看着小姑娘，回忆着自己的前世，心里的怜悯之心动了。如果老人说的是真的，王野想帮一把，都说穷则独善其身，达则兼济天下。王野现在兼济天下不行，但也算不上穷了。但还是怕这一老一小做局行骗，就说：“老先生，我倒是可以买下这只鸭子，可是我得去医院看看，您看可以吗？”

老人知道这是王野不放心，赶紧就开始收拾自己的摊位，说：“可以，当然可以。”

没一会儿，老人收好摊位背上背篓，一手拿着鸭子，一手牵着小姑娘，领着王野出了鸽子市。一直走出去很远，王野才把脸上蒙面的布取下来。

老人见王野年龄不大，就问：“小兄弟看着年龄不大，二十块钱不是小钱要不要......”

王野无所谓的说：“老先生，我工作了，钱是自己挣得，我能做主，放心吧！”

老人笑了一下：“小兄弟真是年少有为呀，年龄不大就已经工作了，不知小兄弟在哪里上班呀？”

王野见老头开始打听他的信息，只是笑了笑，也没有答话。老人也知道自己多嘴了，对王野歉意的笑了笑，就不再说话了。

三人没一会儿就到了医院，现在已经后半夜了，医院没什么人了。老人带着王野来到一间病房。这间病房里只有一个床位上个躺着一个小男孩儿。旁边还有一个老妇人在给男孩擦着身子。那满脸焦急的样子，王野知道老人应该没有撒谎。

妇人见有人进来，抬头看见自家老头子，立刻就问：“老头子，怎么样呀？卖到钱了吗？二娃可不能再等了。”

小丫头赶紧跑到床边，轻轻的抚摸着弟弟的脑袋说：“弟弟，姐姐一定治好你。你可不能丢下姐姐，姐姐就你一个亲人了。”

听着小姑娘的话，王野喉咙里好像堵了一块大石头一样，这还是个孩子，在后世，十来岁的孩子还在跟父母撒泼打滚呢，可是这个姑娘就要挑起家全部的重担。

王野看着小姑娘小小的肩膀一抽一抽的，对旁边的老人说：“老先生，劳烦您找一下值班医生，我问问具体情况。”

老人见王野这么说，应了一声立刻就转身出门了。没一会儿，一个穿着白大褂中年女大夫跟着老人进了病房。

老人赶紧介绍：“小兄弟，这是医院的韩副院长，今天正好值夜班就过来了。”

王野上前一步伸手和副院长握了一下：“院长同志您好，我想了解一下这个孩子的病情。麻烦您可以介绍一下吗？”

副院长也没有说别的，直接就说：“这孩子是急性肺炎，我们已经给他打了小针，可是他这病不是打一针就可以治愈的。所以......”

王野也知道这是要说住院费的问题，直接就问了：“院长同志，病情详细我也不懂，您就不用细说了，就告诉我得多少费用吧？”

副院长想了一下：“最少也要先交十块钱，以后是不是需要继续缴费，得看病情的具体情况。”

王野说：“劳烦院长同志可以带着我去交一次费吗？”

副院长点了下头，转身带着王野出了病房。

在路上，副院长先说话了：“小同志不认识屋里的人吧？”

王野看向副院长满脸询问的表情。

Wang Ye looked at the little girl and recalled his past life, feeling pity in his heart.If what the old man said is true, Wang Ye wants to help. They say that if you are poor, you can benefit yourself, and if you are rich, you can help the world.Wang Ye can't help the world now, but he can't be considered poor.But he was still afraid that the old man and the young man were cheating, so he said, "Old sir, I can buy this duck, but I have to go to the hospital to have a look. Do you think that's okay?"

The old man knew that Wang Ye was worried, so he quickly started to clean up his stall and said, "Okay, of course."

After a while, the old man put away the stall and put the basket on his back. He held the duck in one hand and the little girl in the other, and led Wang Ye out of the pigeon market.Wang Ye didn't take off the mask from his face until he was far out.

Seeing that Wang Ye was young, the old man asked: "Brother, he looks young, twenty yuan is not small change, do you want..."

Wang Ye said nonchalantly: "Old sir, I work, I earn my own money, I can make the decision, don't worry!"

The old man smiled: "My little brother is really young and promising. He is already working at a young age. I wonder where my little brother works?"

When Wang Ye saw the old man asking for information from him, he just smiled and did not answer.The old man also knew that he was talking too much, so he smiled apologetically at Wang Ye and stopped talking.

The three of them arrived at the hospital soon. It was already late at night and there was no one in the hospital.The old man took Wang Ye to a ward.There was only one bed in this ward, and there was a little boy lying on it.There was an old woman wiping the boy's body next to him.With that anxious look on his face, Wang Ye knew that the old man probably wasn't lying.

When the woman saw someone coming in, she looked up and saw her old man. She immediately asked, "Old man, how are you? Did you get enough money from the sale? The second baby can't wait any longer."

The little girl quickly ran to the bed, gently stroked her brother's head and said, "Brother, my sister will definitely cure you. You can't leave your sister behind. She is your only relative."

Listening to the little girl's words, Wang Ye felt as if there was a big stone stuck in his throat. This was still a child. In later generations, teenage children would still be fooling around with their parents, but this girl would bear all the burden of the family.

Wang Ye saw the little girl's little shoulders twitching and said to the old man next to him: "Old sir, could you please find the doctor on duty and I'll ask about the specific situation."

Seeing what Wang Ye said, the old man responded and immediately turned around and went out.After a while, a middle-aged female doctor in a white coat followed the old man into the ward.

The old man quickly introduced: "Little brother, this is Vice President Han of the hospital. He happened to be on night shift today and came here."

Wang Ye stepped forward and reached out to shake hands with the deputy dean: "Hello, comrade dean, I would like to know about this child's condition. Could you please introduce him?"

The vice president didn't say anything else, he just said: "This child has acute pneumonia. We have given him a small injection, but his disease cannot be cured with just one injection. So..."

Wang Ye also knew that this was a question about hospitalization fees, so he asked directly: "Comrade Dean, I don't understand the details of the condition. You don't need to go into details, just tell me how much it will cost?"

The deputy director thought for a moment: "At least ten yuan must be paid first. Whether you need to continue to pay in the future depends on the specific conditions of the disease."

Wang Ye said: "Excuse me, Comrade Dean, can you take me to pay the fee once?"

The vice president nodded, turned around and led Wang Ye out of the ward.

On the way, the deputy dean spoke first: "Young comrade, don't you know the people in the room?"

Wang Ye looked at the deputy dean with a questioning expression on his face.
